description: Gorgias helpdesk integration: ticket context, sidebar data and actions
name: Gorgias

images.title: Swell orders beside every ticket
images.description: When a ticket arrives, the Gorgias sidebar shows the customer's Swell profile and latest orders, each linked to your dashboard.

images.title: Support history in Swell
images.description: Each customer gets a Support tab with open tickets and their latest conversation, and the customer list shows who's waiting.

images.title: Customers synced to Gorgias
images.description: Customers are created in Gorgias with name, email and phone, linked to Swell, and kept current as orders are placed and shipped.

images.title: Connected in minutes
images.description: Enter your Gorgias details and connect once. The integration and sidebar widget are created in Gorgias for you.
